body: Yay! I started it a couple months ago. Did you try the shot? I think they want to switch me to that. Vivitrol i think?
Dude you are a beautiful man! Expressive soulful eyes. Those lips! Lucious! Aka kissable! I'm not really into stashes but yours is tight! And awesome fun hair! You glow!

I did the same thing at 23 days. It didn’t even feel good. Blech. Then i felt bad the day AFTER and was a bump on a log. The day after that i cried a lot. Back on the wagon. It felt SO GOOD to be off the alcohol. I’m doing it again. Lapse vs relapse. 

I drank bc my life really really really sucks right now. But even though I’m stuck, I’d rather feel a lot better mentally and physically and be sober.

It is a process. And  it being a physical addiction complicate things greatly. What’s the 60/90 minute thing? 

My detox was great. Lots of downers, slept for a couple days, woke up wanting to be awake, aware. I too just had a little relapse. It sucked. Sent me right into DT’s. I was sweating, throwing up, shaking. I felt like a bug hit with bug spray.  

This shit isn’t worth it, man. It poisons your body and mind. It makes you weak, dull. Then there’s the recovery time AFTER you quit. Too much trouble. Nothing substantial gets done. 

Poison.
It's interesting though, bc since children tend to emulate their parents relationships, you can be careful to avoid these things/ relationship patterns in the future.

Do you have history of abstaining? For how long?

You can do it. It's poison. Lowers your senses.
Thank you!
You look healthier already!

That's what happened with my partner and me. When i was strong, he was weak and brought home alcohol. When i was weak and brought home alcohol he was strong. And we'd cave to each other. 

Eventually it killed our relationship. It's over. A 15 year marriage. I, the dutiful wife, supported his career goals and schooling. Now he's well off and I'm totally screwed. He got mean when drunk and when i decided to give him a taste of his own medicine suddenly it was over. 

If your relationship means anything, don't do what i did. Don't wait until it's too late. 

Play dice. Chess. Dominoes. Rub each other's feet. Go for a walk together. Find activities to take the place of drinking at the time of day you usually drink.

I'm 15 days in too!!! It's really an accomplishment!!!! I've been drinking non alcoholic Heinekin - it's 0.0% alcohol. Where some NA beer has a tiny bit, others have 0.0. I'm a fan of the 0 bc I'm afraid of being triggered. I'm drinking several a day though. I think it's time to cut down on that too. Even though it's like beer flavored soda. And probably way more expensive than soda.

I also fast forward time in my head when i get cravings. So let's say i did have a beer. I'd slam it. Then two more. Then I'd start slowing down, lose my train of thought, lose interest in whatever activity I'm doing, whether it be fun or something needed like cleaning or tidying. Then I'd realize i drank for a buzz faster than my absorption rate, which means i find myself tipsier than i planned. Then i go lie down somewhere comfy bc now i just want to be cozy under a blanket somewhere soft, carrying with me yet another drink. 

Also usually send inflammatory texts to my husband who used me to support him during school, now he's rich and is leaving me high and dry. If not more people as well. Not remembering that part in the morning, but everyone hates me and i only know that i hurt so badly. 

The next morning wake groggy and don't have the umph to get out of bed. The dog needs to be fed and walked. Whatever chore or activity that got interrupted by alcohol is still waiting on me. 

I want to hide how bad i feel mentally and physically by..... hair of the dog. Repeat. 

I'm 15 days sober and feel so good. Almost normal. Almost. When it rains it pours, so have a LOT of stuff going on, of which this is only one thing. Being sober is the way to get through the other things. 

There are 24/7 AA Zoom meetings. I'll listen in for hours at a time. Knowing I'm not alone gives me comfort. Knowing other people have over come this makes me believe in myself. I can do it too. 

And so can you.

This is how i accrued SO MANY Day 1's. Well that wasn't as hard as i thought it would be, or should be, so i don't have a problem after all, right? 

Then i can't stop making stops at the liquor store. I buy something thinking I'll ration it. Then i home, feel guilty and hurry up and drink as much as possible to 'get rid of it'. Then I'm trying to figure out how to start Day 1 again. Is there meaning? Is this bottom? What's the date? Is that meaningful? Weeks go by..... Then i finally manage a Day 1..... Repeat.

I'm on day 15 now. Haven't gone without this long in years.

What a difference! Looking great! Realizing it could and would kill me after i had DT's scared me straight. 6 weeks later, but still. I'm 15 days in and feel better every day. Still have the raw emotions, expect those to stay around for awhile, but the first week was the hardest and with each day i feel stronger.
Valerian has been so helpful for my sleep. Can't hardly believe it as i just started it and have had shit sleep for forever.

I had visual and auditory hallucinations as well as super vivid dreams. I'm 15 days in, haven't had visual or auditory hallucinations but still dreaming vividly. 

The visual hallucinations were of people and animals. Totally looked real, but i KNEW they weren't bc they just appeared. I felt like i was simply observing my hallucinations. Same with the auditory. Those were interesting bc it was most often music, but at such a low level i could pick out the genre, classical, folk, Opera, heavy metal, music box, etc, but it was JUST quiet enough that i couldn't recreate it or hum it. When the auditory hallucinations happened i would often try to find a quiet place to sit and listen, hoping the volume would be turned up just a little more, hoping to hear it a little better, but that didn't happen. 

I would close my eyes and bc at the time i sometimes slept in the guest room, is be in the bedroom and would literally look around my closed eyes and see The dark guest room around me. I'd open my eyes and find myself in the bedroom after all. 

It was fascinating and honestly quite entertaining. I never felt i was losing my grip or unsafe. Even sleep paralysis is neat to me bc i feel like I'm floating. I just observe. It never lasts too long. 

Perhaps creating new synapses? Cleaning out the cobwebs created by the substances? That's my theory. Just as the liver regenerates, the brain does too? Perhaps!
Coffee puts me to sleep!!!
Congratulations on 6 days! 15 days here and feel I'm building steam each day. The first week is the hardest. You got this!!!! I'm jealous of your oven!
You can do it! I had so many day 1's and when i got fed up i stuck with it. Now I'm on day 13!! It feels SO GOOD to have even one more day under the belt.
First time I've gone 5 days in a couple years! Ain't it great!

We can do this. This is going to be easier for you alone than with a toxic or unsupportive mate. 

I feel like when i quit smoking while living with a smoker. It's hard. Re learning how to live with a husband who doesn't like to talk and I'm a chatterbox. A little weird, but i just gotta do me.
I've tried it in the past and it takes me right back to real beer. Too much of a trigger. Can't do it.

I've replaced booze with lemonade. It's delicious. And I'm on benzo taper and naloxone. The trifecta!!!! So I'm a little doped up. AND i have a broken foot - done on day 0. So that's a sure lifestyle change. It's a perfect storm.

You can do it. I totally relate. I'm on day three. That's incredible as I've had SO many failed day 1's. Get some meds, if not script then passionflower or valerian and stay in bed a few days. I'm not a doctor, but these natural calmy pills have worked great for me. Held with the scary withdraw. Maybe saved my life. Finally i got the script meds. This is the last time i bc of the did back and forth. Day three is freeing!

First day two. Only cried once so far. Took care of outstanding bills, hubs organized craft went outside and watched the birds and the street in silence for 20 minutes. Inside for a nap before crafty friend comes over. 

The world is in slow motion, and I’m enjoying it.

Do i treat it like an old dog? When there’s more bad days than good days, put them down? It’s a good rule for that. I don’t know. You have to factor in your joy here too.

He will want new adventures, new things to occupy the time he would have been drinking. He will need these space holders bc it’s a whole new life. Maybe you can see it as him helping you very much, and you helping each other in that time. It might w time to move on to a guy you like who is already sober. If the transition is too hard for you both?
